# `kernel/other/stand.att` — the BSD45 port glue (boot, monitor, syscall bridge) (AT&T-derived standalone code)

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains the BSD45 port glue (boot, monitor, syscall bridge) (AT&T-derived standalone code).

`config.mk` records 8 source file(s) here: `cat.c`, `copy.c`, `dev.c`, `getfile.c`, `gets.c`, `ls.c`, `printf.c`, `stat.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.

## 中文

本目录包含BSD45 端口的 glue 代码（启动、monitor、系统调用桥）（AT&T 派生的独立代码）。

`config.mk` 记录了 8 个源文件：`cat.c`、`copy.c`、`dev.c`、`getfile.c`、`gets.c`、`ls.c`、`printf.c`、`stat.c`。

这些 `config.mk` 清单来自 4.5BSD 源码树，是参考元数据；BSD45 的构建脚本（`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`）会显式选择实际参与编译的文件。
